narration: [chintu] <bookmark mark='chintu'/>Two to the power negative one must be negative two.
<bookmark mark='piece'/>The piece of strip is still there, so its length is more than nought.
<bookmark mark='strike'/>A length cannot be negative, so the bubble is wrong.
removed_beats.on_screen: Chintu's bubble shows 2⁻¹ = −2; the half unit piece glows; a length cannot be below zero; the bubble is struck through in the warning colour

narration: <bookmark mark='think'/>A negative exponent means one over the same power with a positive exponent.
<bookmark mark='yours'/>Your turn. A strip eight units long is halved five times. Write its length as a power of two.
removed_beats.on_screen: the line negative exponent, one over the power appears; a new strip of 8 units, halved 5 times, appears with an empty box
